connectedWorkflow.status: implemented; independently reviewed; no user aesthetic approval
rules: Essential consequences and real actions precede large illustrations.
Physical note face, invoice credit amount, reversals and matched shares retain separate meanings.
Declined offers are terminal and retain their recorded reason.
Recorded comparisons retain event-time economics and prior terms.
Source and message drafts remain bound to exact reviews; cancelling clears local source edits.
Unsent email attachments contain exact approved source originals.

team.time: Saved-case walkthrough clock, separate from financial/event time. Pause, reverse, seek, reduced motion and visibility suspension.
team.sourceInspection: TeamSourcePanel preserves exact ID/revision, original text/download and selected-worker/playhead context. Direct source URLs and reload stay paused; full Documents is a secondary route.

narrative.northStar: A case moves between recognizable teammates; every handoff opens the real evidence and next authorized action.
narrative.overview: A primary original working studio and one open visual system replace the rejected green/manila frame. Saved-case findings and visual handoffs remain distinct from actual recorded financial events.
keyCharacteristics: Team is the primary root experience; Cases, Documents, Companies and Reports remain connected workspaces.
Five stable original worker figures share identity with their portraits, tools and exact source-backed findings.
Open warm-white working surface and compact neutral navigation replace the rejected green/manila frame.
Physical pickup, travel, paired exchange and return are driven by one reversible scene clock.
Source inspection stays in the scene, preserving selected worker, exact version and paused playhead; full Documents remains available.
Recorded actors/events and real financial actions remain distinct from software-role walkthroughs.

rules.name: Keep the handoff bound
rules.body: The bubble, selected worker, artifact and opened source/action share exact IDs and versions. Original and accepted terms retain separate evidence.

rules.name: Keep the scene honest
rules.body: Visual playback is a saved-case walkthrough. Approval, execution, sending and invoice application require their actual separate records.

rules.name: Keep camera ownership
rules.body: Drag/zoom take ownership; every deliberate inspection, including repeated selection, can reframe the worker. Phone views focus useful figures rather than a miniature world.

rules.name: Keep evidence in context
rules.body: Source URLs, reload, close and browser Back preserve exact source selection and pause the scene. Phone source close restores the same teammate sheet and focus.

dos: Keep the same role figure and portrait through a handoff.
Keep exact sources, actions, actors, dates and cents bound to the selected case.
Frame the working pair or selected person at useful phone scale.
Judge actual normal motion and source/action outcomes, not test counts.
donts: Do not restore the rejected blue-gray dashboard or treat Formroom candidates as approved templates.
Do not label generated summary art as an original vendor invoice.
Do not confuse recording a domain action with composing or sending email.
Do not infer user approval, public deployment, native Figma parity or connected external services from tests.
